crossRefs.note: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed…
Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
translations.bsb: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
translations.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
translations.asv: Then after this he saith to the disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
